title: Block Range And Steps
description: Defines an integer block state with a range of valid values and optional step increment. Used for block properties like growth stages (0-7 for crops), signal strength (0-15 for redstone), or rotation angles. The game only allows values within the specified min/max range at the given step intervals.

range.title: Range
range.description: The range of the random offset.
range.x-runtime-constraint-description: Check that the limits imposed on the range (minimum, maximum and maximum distance between values) are respected

steps.title: Steps
steps.description: The number of steps between the range. Specify 0 for all possible values between the range.
